parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, phone, total_bookings, last_booking_date
FROM batutynas.contacts
WHERE phone = $1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.id, b.event_date, b.event_time, b.delivery_address, b.city, b.status,
       c.name AS customer_name
FROM batutynas.bookings b
JOIN batutynas.contacts c ON c.id = b.contact_id
WHERE b.event_date = $1::date
  AND b.status IN ('Confirmed', 'Delivered')
  AND LOWER(b.city) = LOWER($2)
ORDER BY b.event_time;
